findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/done-effects.ts:131-137 watches package.json, root package-lock.json, and packages/main package metadata for the post-DONE build predicate, but omits packages/main/package-lock.json even though packages/main/package.json runs the build in that package and the repository contains a package-local lockfile. A DONE merge that changes only packages/main/package-lock.json will skip runDoneMainPackageBuildAfterMerge, leaving the local main dist unrefreshed under the dependency graph the package actually uses. The smoke coverage in packages/main/src/tasks/worktree-authority-smoke.ts:816-849 also omits this path, so the regression is not guarded.
findings.resolvedReason: Include packages/main/package-lock.json in the DONE post-merge build trigger and smoke coverage so dependency lockfile-only changes refresh packages/main/dist.

findings.desc: Concept blocker: the normal story_advance DONE path refreshes packages/main/dist after a runtime-input merge via runDoneMainPackageBuildAfterMerge (packages/main/src/handlers/done-effects.ts:739), but done_recover has an independent recovery merge path that merges a partial-DONE story branch into main (packages/main/src/handlers/done-recover.ts:75-80) and then cleans the worktree/branch without invoking the build hook or documenting an equivalent guarantee. Because done_recover is the documented command for completing partial-DONE merges (docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md:160), a recovered story that changes packages/main/src can leave main merged while global lattice still sees stale packages/main/dist. This weakens the hard product rule that runtime-affecting packages/main changes merged by DONE are immediately visible to the global CLI.
findings.resolvedReason: done_recover now invokes the shared post-merge packages/main build hook after recovery merges, with smoke coverage and lifecycle docs updated.
